title: sorbus harrowiana
intro: Sorbus harrowiana, commonly known as Rowan or Mountain Ash, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Himalayas and China. The Rowan plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and exhibiting antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include acting as an antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral agent, which may help in the management of conditions such as arthritis and respiratory infections. The bioactive constituents present in Sorbus harrowiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
